seo.title: Meet the team — Clearline Pest Solutions
seo.description: The licensed technicians, inspectors and office crew behind Clearline Pest Solutions. Family owned and protecting homes across the Phoenix valley since 2011.

image.alt: Black widow spider specimen, front view

sections.heading: Meet the team behind Clearline Pest Solutions.
sections.body: Licensed technicians, termite inspectors and an office crew who treat every home like their own. Get to know the people keeping pests out across the Phoenix valley.

sections.heading: The people powering your service.
sections.intro: Technicians, inspectors and office staff who show up on time and stand behind the work. Add each person's photo in Site Settings.

members.name: Marcus Reyes
members.bio: 18 years in pest control. Started the company on a simple promise: show the customer the work.

members.name: Daniela Cruz
members.bio: Runs scheduling, routing and quality control across every truck on the road.

members.name: Tyrone Walker
members.bio: Scorpion specialist and our UV hunt lead. Eight years with the team.

members.name: Priya Anand
members.bio: Licensed WDI inspector. Writes the reports agents and lenders actually read.

members.name: Jamal Foster
members.bio: Seals roof lines, vents and weep screeds so rodents and scorpions have nowhere left to go.

members.name: Sophia Nguyen
members.bio: The friendly voice on the phone, booking inspections and keeping every visit on track.

sections.heading: Want to join the crew?
sections.body: We are always looking for technicians, inspectors and office staff who share our standards. Paid licensing, steady routes, and a company truck.
